Floor held at 101; quantified the loop.c gate that costs the 7th callee-saved register (threshold bracketed 26..29, insn 312 savings 1 lifetime 2) and PROVED that killing that hoist alone restores tar

Floor 101 -> 99 and build_insns 193 -> 194 (= target's 194): declaring D_800A3590 as an array of a 2-byte record routes the read through expand_expr's COMPONENT_REF/get_inner_reference offset path, wh

Floor 99 -> 56: giving var_s0 three source increment sites raises loop.c's bl->biv_count to 3, zeroing the D_800A3590 address giv's benefit so strength_reduce REJECTS the reduction that s3 pinned as t

Floor 56 -> 53 and every FAKE construct retired: spelling the second loop as a top-test for() whose secondary counters are expressions of the loop variable makes jump.c's duplicate_loop_exit_test fire

Floor 53 -> 39 at 194 insns (== target) with an EXACT frame: the 0x18 overshoot was three reload spill slots proven by BB2_FRAME_DEBUG, and reverting s5's top-test for to an if-guarded do/while remove

frontier.hypothesis: The last four points are the target holding $a1 = D_800A35B0 and $a2 = lhu D_800A3558 live across the loop (loaded in the guard block at 80070DF4/DFC, re-loaded in the loop TAIL at 80070ECC-ED4, consumed by sll $v0,$a2,16 / sra / addu $v0,$a1,$v0 at 80070E78-E80). We re-load both inside the body every iteration. Reaching that WITHOUT the top-test loop's 24 frame bytes is the whole remaining problem.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c:7909 cse_set_around_loop needs REG_LOOP_TEST_P (cse.c:7936), set only by jump.c:2253 in duplicate_loop_exit_test, which needs a top-test loop -- and that same routine's gen_reg_rtx (jump.c:2246) is what leaves the three dead pseudos. So EITHER find a top-test spelling in which every copied exit-test insn SURVIVES combine (the target's guard block keeps all six of its insns: lhu, lw, lh, addiu, addu, blez -- ours collapses a load plus sign-extend into one lh and orphans the REG_DEAD notes), OR find a non-cse_around_loop route to the same register reuse.
frontier.next_probe: On the top-test for chassis (tmp/grind/func_80070C70/s6/struct/i2_m1_d32.c, score 49), dump with pwsh tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_80070C70 and read text1b.combine for WHICH copied guard insns combine deletes and which REG_DEAD notes it orphans; then sweep guard-block spellings that stop that fold -- in particular forms in which the guard's two reads of D_800A3558 cannot be folded into a single lh (a separate function-scope local holding one of them, the two reads at different widths, or the guard expression written so the sign-extension and the load land in different insns). Verify each with the 1-second vars= gradient (tmp/grind/func_80070C70/s6/varsweep.sh) before spending a sandbox measurement: the target is vars= 80.

frontier.hypothesis: `t = prim.p_geom + 0xC` is emitted into the SAME register as p_geom (addiu $v0,$v0,12) at three sites where the target keeps two live registers (addiu $v1,$v0,12).
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc coalesces the add's destination onto its source when the source dies at that insn. The target's p_geom read stays live past the add, which means in the original source the read feeding the add is used again afterwards (or is a different pseudo).
frontier.next_probe: Sweep the three sites (the pre-loop prim.p_static = prim.p_geom + 0xC, the pre-do/while prim.p_geom + 0x48, and the loop body's t) for spellings that keep p_geom live: reading prim.p_geom again after the add, computing the addend from ctx_or_var_s2 instead of from prim.p_geom, and naming the p_geom read in its own local. Read text1b.lreg for the qty coalescing decision on each.

frontier.hypothesis: `s32 ctx = var_s0 * 3;` is a named intermediate that must clear that family's 6 prongs (or be replaced by an ordinary-C equivalent) before this function can be submitted.
frontier.mechanism: Family-selection table: FRESH local, once-written once-read, real consumed value -> named-intermediate, .claude/rules/narrow-byte-args-packed-call.md plus the 2026-08-17 clarification in .claude/rules/no-new-park-categories.md; 6 prongs, FAKE annotation plus dumps required.
frontier.next_probe: Before candidate-ready, read that rule end to end and answer the six prongs in self_vet.md, or measure whether the `u8 *p = D_800A3560 + var_s0 * 3;` pointer-local spelling (identical score) clears an easier bar. If neither is clearly inside a sanctioned family, emit ruling-request naming both spellings rather than submitting.
